name: Eureka Mine
author: Claude - Oretsej
description: A race map in a Pennsylvania coal mine. The grid is in the pithead yard under the breaker; the race runs into the drift mouth and down the slope, and every lap after that is underground: the haulage, a plane where runaway mine cars break loose, the lower gangway under coal chutes, the old workings that cross over it, a spiral up to the upper gangway, the overcast above the haulage, and switchbacks with a coal chute beside them behind swinging ventilation doors. About 6.5 km a lap. Dealt into the run map like any other map.
